criteria.criterion: README.md is at most 200 lines, in this order: what vloop is; prerequisites (Go as in go.mod, git, the claude CLI, workspace trust); install (`go install github.com/mvelosop/vloop/cmd/vloop@v<tag>` at a release tag; the plugin through --plugin-dir while the repository is private); a quickstart (vloop init, a [[check]], vloop doctor, vloop brief new, brief check, vloop run, vloop brief close); the loop in one paragraph (plan, gate folders, the gate review, work, gates, checks, review, one commit); the everyday commands in a short list pointing at docs/guide/commands.md; exit codes in brief, pointing at the concepts guide; the guides; "What changed in 2.0".
criteria.evidence: README.md is 110 lines; sections appear in the required order (a short Skills section sits between Guides and What changed, a harmless addition).

criteria.criterion: There is no command table, and no marketplace install step.
criteria.evidence: The table is gone; the only mention of a marketplace says there is none, and install uses claude --plugin-dir.

criteria.criterion: Any claim that errors are one line starting `vloop: ` carries the qualification (after the checks doctor or a preflight prints).
criteria.evidence: README.md Exit codes: "once the checks `vloop doctor` and a preflight print have run".

criteria.criterion: The README test keeps its 200-line cap; completeness checks that the README no longer carries (config keys, commands) live in the guides' tests instead, not deleted.
criteria.evidence: readmeLineCap stays 200 in internal/cli/readme_test.go; the only change is allowing the claude flag --plugin-dir. guide_test.go and commands_doc_test.go hold the completeness checks.

criteria.criterion: Every relative link in README.md resolves.
criteria.evidence: All linked guides exist in docs/guide/; the concepts.md anchors #exit-codes and #what-changed-in-20 match headings at lines 149 and 121.

notes: The readme_test.go change (claudeFlags allowlist) is needed because the README must name --plugin-dir; it loosens a pre-existing test only for that one flag.
